title: EXP-110-R3 - Finish Hello World Part 7 Section 7: Read Back ButtonSignIn and ButtonHome After the Operator Reload, Complete ButtonCart (Caption FX_sCart = Cart, Theme Class FX_BlueButton, Size 15; 2) with a Save After Each Step and a Console-Error Stop, Then Close/Reopen Readback of All Three Buttons
objective: Finish Hello World Part 7 Section 7 after EXP-110-R2 stopped at ButtonCart step B. T1 reads back, without change, what persisted after the operator's Designer reload: the Buttons under FlexLayoutMain > Region00: menu with their Name, Caption, Theme Class and Size, and the strings FX_sSignIn, FX_sHome and FX_sCart. T2 completes ButtonCart from the first step that did not persist (A placement and Name, B Caption FX_sCart and string FX_sCart = Cart, C Theme Class FX_BlueButton, D Size 15; 2) with a Designer Save after each step, stopping before any further server event if the page console error count rises. T3 verifies all three Buttons after an ordinary close and reopen and writes the final audit. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md (the repository file, at the start of every task), docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt7.md Section 7 (lines 205-217) and transcript lines 10:54-12:08, recipes/components/add-component-from-toolbox.md, recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-110-R2, EXP-110 and EXP-109 records. Read nothing else: no other records and no Part 7 Section 8 or later.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-110-R3-hello-world-part-7-section-7-buttoncart-and-readback.md and evidence/EXP-110-R3/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If a session expiry, logout card or sign-in page appears, record it and stop for the operator (EXP-107: the operator signs in manually); do not navigate, type credentials or screenshot a filled sign-in form. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, dialog, menu or unsaved change open across tasks. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action.
Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error. Console-error stop (EXP-110-R2 lesson: a Caption commit can fail silently with HTTP 400 and surface only at the next server event): record the page console error count shown in the browser tool output at the start of each task and after every action in T2; if it rises after any action, record the action and the counts and stop blocked before any further click (no ellipsis, no Save, no close), leaving the state for the operator. Never read or inspect the console messages themselves.

Designer gate (T1, read-only except at most one reopen): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if it is not open (the operator's reload may have closed it), open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record the Components tree under FlexLayoutMain > Region00: menu and the five other regions (spacer1, signinpage, homepage, cartpage, spacer2; header and footer components unchanged, the footer's Region00: UNKNOWN0 noted as already present). Select each Button under Region00: menu by its Components row (selection only) and record Name, Caption, Theme Class and Size. Expected: ButtonSignIn (FX_sSignIn, FX_BlueButton, 15; 2), ButtonHome (FX_sHome, FX_BlueButton, 15; 2) in that order, then possibly ButtonCart in any partial state, or no ButtonCart. Record what the canvas labels show (raw IDs or the string values). If ButtonSignIn or ButtonHome is missing or differs from its expected values, or any other component is in the menu region, record it and stop blocked (no repair in this run).

String check (T1, read-only): open Designer Edit menu > String once (Global Objects, Strings filter). Filter FX_sCustomerPortal as a positive control (expected one row), then FX_sSignIn (expected Sign In), FX_sHome (expected Home) and FX_sCart; record each result and value with one screenshot and leave with Cancel; verify Save is still disabled. If FX_sSignIn or FX_sHome is absent or has another value, record it and stop blocked. FX_sCart may be absent or present: present with exactly Cart is reused in step B without the ellipsis; present with any other value stops the run blocked.

Efficiency rules (operator, 2026-10-16): screenshots only for the decisive states named in this brief; do not re-open saved images unless a decision needs it; one untargeted snapshot per step; read only the named sources; never search or read the worker's own session transcript. Use inline untargeted snapshots; never save snapshots to files and Grep them (EXP-109 ran out of turns that way).

Button rules (EXP-105 to EXP-110-R2): placement: click the Button row in the Toolbox once, then click once inside the menu region on the canvas (below ButtonHome, away from edges, dividers and adorner icons); record the Components tree (the new Button must be a child of FlexLayoutMain > Region00: menu, below ButtonSignIn and ButtonHome); a misplacement gets the toolbar Undo once and stops blocked. Never drag or reorder. Name: plain fill and Tab. Record the console error count after leaving each field. Caption (EXP-110 finding): click the Caption value cell to open its list, type the string ID key by key, then leave the field by clicking the Description row, never by Tab (Tab commits the highlighted first list item); never take an accessibility snapshot while the Caption list is open (it exceeds the tool limit, EXP-110): use a screenshot there, and snapshot after leaving the field; verify the committed Caption. String: if T1 found the string with its planned value, do not click the ellipsis; otherwise click the Caption ellipsis once, expect the prompt 'String <ID> does not exist. Create it?' (record verbatim), Yes once, in the String editor replace the pre-filled value with the planned value by one plain fill and Tab, verify, OK once; if the prompt names another ID or an editor shows an existing value, leave it with OK unchanged and stop blocked. Theme Class: open the list, click FX_BlueButton, Tab. Size: double-click the Layout Size row, then Width 15 and Height 2 by plain fill and Tab each; record the Size summary after each entry (EXP-110: it stayed 14.25; 1.89) and after the Save. At most one correction per field. Steps and Saves: A placement and Name; B Caption and string; C Theme Class; D Size; after each step exactly one Designer Save, recording its response and the Save state. If a Save raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record the step and stop blocked (no retry, no further step, no close). Screenshots: placement with the tree, the prompt and String editor (if created), each Save response, the Size rows before Save D.

ButtonCart (T2): by the Button rules, start at the first step that T1 found not persisted and do the remaining steps in order with one Designer Save after each: A placement and Name ButtonCart (only if T1 found no ButtonCart; if ButtonCart exists, select it by its Components row instead); B Caption FX_sCart (skip the entry if T1 read Caption FX_sCart) and string FX_sCart = Cart (created through the ellipsis only if T1 found it absent); C Theme Class FX_BlueButton (skip if already set); D Width 15, Height 2 (skip if already 15; 2). A skipped step gets no Save. Stop at the end of the task.

Readback and audit (T3, one task): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, record the Components tree (the three Buttons under Region00: menu in order), select each Button by its Components row and record Name, Caption, Theme Class and Size, record what the canvas shows (expected: three blue buttons labelled Sign In, Home and Cart stacked in the menu column), and check the three strings read-only through Edit menu > String (filter each ID; Cancel). Leave the Form open and clean. Then, in the same task, write the documentation-only final audit into the record: decisive evidence for each acceptance check, the cumulative action audit with exact counts, the worker-written-file inventory, the cleanup inventory and the final state. Screenshots: the reopened canvas with the tree, and one Strings check.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Coordinates are allowed only for the one ButtonCart canvas placement click (T2, only if ButtonCart is absent); record each such click. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection; never leave a prompt, editor or dialog open across tasks. Classify findings as observed only.
out_of_scope: Part 7 Section 8 and later (the sign-in, home and cart page contents); click events, navigation, visibility conditions or page switching for the Buttons; Regenerate Form; the deferred StaticCustID binding.

Any change to existing components or regions (root FlexLayout, FlexLayoutHeader and its Statics, FlexLayoutMain and its regions, FlexLayoutFooter); any component other than the three new Buttons; deleting or moving any component or region.
Regenerate Form (not authorized in this run).
Any other Form, including FX_FlexProbe01; Site Default or Group scope.
Creating or changing global objects other than the new string FX_sCart: other strings, images, the theme FX_HelloWorld and its classes, variables; IDOs, SQL objects and stored data.
Any runtime action in the Web Client.
Check Out, Check In, Undo Check Out or other checkout-management actions; FormSync, deployment; any cache or metadata unload.
Direct SQL execution, browser JavaScript, console or network inspection, direct URL navigation (except the portal step of the session-expiry procedure), refresh or restart.
Modifying earlier experiment records, AGENTS.md, tutorial sources, recipes, assets or files outside the EXP-110 paths.

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security

Never place more than one component (ButtonCart in T2, only if T1 found it absent); never use mouse dragging; Undo at most once and only to remove a misplaced new ButtonCart before any other change to it.
Never change any existing component or region; never delete, move or reorder a component or a region.
Never set any attribute other than ButtonCart's Name, Caption, Theme Class and Size (Width, Height); never change ButtonSignIn or ButtonHome; never add an event handler or response.

Never create or edit any global object other than the string FX_sCart, created at most once through the ButtonCart Caption ellipsis prompt and only if T1 found it absent; never edit an existing string.
Never click Regenerate Form or Delete Form Definition.
Never edit or save any other Form; never perform any runtime action.
Never click Select Form OK; open FX_CustomerPortal only through the recent-forms entry.
Never go beyond the current task instruction; stop at its end even when later brief steps remain.

Never invoke the Designer Save more than four times in T2 (once after each performed step A to D) or at all in T1 and T3; never retry an uncertain Save; never Save after an error or after the console error count rose.
Never answer Yes to a prompt that would delete, discard or replace anything; record every prompt verbatim.
Never invoke any unload, in the Web Client or the Designer.
Never perform check-in, undo checkout or other checkout-management actions, FormSync or deployment.

Never use direct SQL, application internals or browser JavaScript; never refresh, restart or replace the browser session; re-login only through the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure, at most once per task.
Never claim cross-session durability, database-level durability or replay verification from same-session UI observations.

artifacts: ButtonSignIn, ButtonHome (from EXP-110-R2, read back only) and ButtonCart (completed here) in FlexLayoutMain's menu region of FX_CustomerPortal; Theme Class FX_BlueButton; Size 15; 2
Strings FX_sSignIn = Sign In, FX_sHome = Home (from EXP-110-R2, read only) and FX_sCart = Cart (new, tenant-wide, created through the Caption ellipsis if absent)

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed at the start of each task; session usable; User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean; tree and properties recorded for every Button under Region00: menu (ButtonSignIn and ButtonHome as expected); canvas labels recorded; string check recorded for FX_sCustomerPortal (found), FX_sSignIn = Sign In, FX_sHome = Home and FX_sCart (absent or Cart); baseline console error count recorded. Evidence: gate and string screenshots.

In T2, ButtonCart completed under FlexLayoutMain > Region00: menu after ButtonHome from the first step not persisted: each performed step followed by one Designer Save with its response; Name ButtonCart, Caption FX_sCart, string FX_sCart = Cart created only when absent, Theme Class FX_BlueButton and Size 15; 2 with the Size summary recorded; console error count recorded after every action (or, at a rise or a server-event error, the action recorded and the run stopped); at most one correction per field. No other component, region or Form changed; no global object created or changed except the string FX_sCart; no event handler; no Regenerate; no dragging; Undo used at most once per task and only as allowed; no runtime action; no unload; no checkout action; User scope only; no task-boundary overrun.

The final audit (written in T3) gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-4, the action audit with exact counts (Toolbox selections, placement clicks, Undo clicks, per-field entries and corrections, prompts with texts and answers, String editor OKs, list opens, Designer Saves with responses, Form closes and reopens, errors, re-logins), the worker-written-file inventory, the cleanup inventory (three Buttons ButtonSignIn, ButtonHome, ButtonCart; three strings FX_sSignIn, FX_sHome, FX_sCart, of which EXP-110-R2 created two) and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.
